result.summary: Server fix implemented, tested, and independently approved, but NOT deployed: the harness denied the authorized fast-forward push of a428fbda to combined-app-platform-cutover twice (first as 'Production Deploy', then 'Blocked by classifier') even after the Founder authorized it in chat. Production is unchanged (deployment 7292d936 ACTIVE on 714dcaef, web and worker). The fix: canonical photo sessions now also own legacy progressPhotos rows whose imagePath is the ORIGINAL of a photo that is displayed via a JPEG derivative (DNG/HEIC), in both createPhotoSessionReadModels and createPhotoSessionLandingSummary. Read-model only, no data mutation. Root cause reverified against real production state: the base code yields 19 sessions with the duplicate legacy-photo-session-photo-assets-7krsg5 as latest (first image is the DNG original, no briefing under that id); the candidate code run read-only against the same state yields 18 sessions, canonical Sep 19 latest, first image = the JPEG derivative, Sep 19 published briefing found, 10 legacy-only historical sessions and all 49 stored legacy rows untouched.

tests.summary: 9 new regression tests pass (8 in CanonicalPhotoSessionReadService.test.js, 1 end-to-end Native projection test in ProgressPhotosReadService.test.js); 6 of them plus the end-to-end test fail on the unfixed source. Full unit suite: candidate 8194 tests / 298 failures vs pristine base 8185 / 298; zero candidate-only failures, all 298 are pre-existing environmental (for example missing private/founder/runtime-store.json), identical by test name. Phase suites vs base: phase3 274 tests/1 fail both, phase4 137/0 both, phase6 521 vs 513 tests/3 fail both, phase6.photo 94 vs 86 tests/2 fail both; zero candidate-only failures. Production build (webpack, provider isolated) compiled successfully and the compiled correction marker is present in two server chunks and absent from a base build. ESLint clean on changed files; git diff --check clean.

review.summary: Independent reviewer (fresh-context agent) verdict APPROVE for exact candidate a428fbda: no blockers, no majors. Original-path ownership sufficient and correctly scoped; no legitimate legacy-only session disappears; DNG derivative display and all session output fields unchanged; landing and detailed agree for realistic inputs; no production mutation required. Minor notes accepted without changing the reviewed SHA: ownership map is keyed by canonicalId (only wrong under a duplicate canonicalId with different fingerprints, a store invariant violation, and production canonical ids are distinct); two test assertions are weaker than ideal (an inactive-photo case and a tautological briefing-id check); read-time comparison output for later sessions after any earlier HEIC/DNG session with legacy rows will now compare against the canonical derivative, which is an improvement.

zero_write_audit.summary: Predeploy baseline captured read-only through the approved console runner (REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY, transaction_read_only=on verified, owner-scoped, ROLLBACK): Sep 19 canonical session is a singleton with 5 photos; the 10 referenced media rows exist and are verified; 5 legacy Sep 19 rows; exactly 1 Sep 19 Photo Event briefing; no pending outbox (12 dead, 765 succeeded, pre-existing) and no pending evidence reviews; 14 migrations, last 000014; 29 per-collection digests and 52 briefing digests recorded. Candidate and base read-model proofs also ran inside the production component in read-only transactions. No writes anywhere; no postdeploy audit was possible because nothing was deployed.
